description: Defines an abstract class 'pdcch_resource_allocator' for PDCCH resource allocation in a cellular network, including methods for allocating and canceling PDCCH resources for both common and UE-specific use cases.

classes.name: pdcch_resource_allocator
classes.description: Abstract class providing interface for PDCCH resource allocation algorithms, including methods for common and UE-specific PDCCH resource management.

methods.name: alloc_dl_pdcch_common
methods.description: Allocates RE space for common PDCCH, avoiding collisions with other PDCCH allocations.

methods.name: alloc_ul_pdcch_common
methods.description: Allocates RE space for common UL PDCCH, avoiding collisions with other PDCCH allocations.

methods.name: alloc_dl_pdcch_ue
methods.description: Allocates RE space for UE-dedicated DL PDCCH, avoiding collisions with other PDCCH allocations.

methods.name: alloc_ul_pdcch_ue
methods.description: Allocates RE space for UE-dedicated UL PDCCH, avoiding collisions with other PDCCH allocations.
